stem: Which application of a new technology can be attributed to an invention of Thomas Edison?

options.label: A
options.text: Refrigerated railroad cars allowed food to be transported long distances.

options.label: B
options.text: Light bulbs made it efficient for factory workers to work at night.

options.label: C
options.text: Diesel engines were used in the production of airplanes.

options.label: D
options.text: Sonar technology was used to track submarines.
